name: Misaki Keigo
source:
2nd year high school student.
The protagonist's classmate. A composed guy who is accomplished both in the literary and military arts.
An aloof guy who has an intimidating air about him that makes him hard to approach.
An obstinate and stubborn guy who is no good at spoiling people.
He's a former customer of the protagonist's mother and after her disappearance he comes to the protagonist to get his fortune told.
